messages:
release-manager: Kicking off staged deploy for service-inference v2.0.2. Plan: canary 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 40m. Will toggle ff:rollout-model-v2.

deploy-bot: deploy started to canary (5%) at 13:00 UTC — build: sha:abc123. health checks passing 6/6 — 30s avg latency +3ms

maya.dev: holding on EU region? we saw latency spike last night, recommend EU holdback for first 20m

sam: +1 to hold EU for first window. can we pin model to v2.0.1 for EU traffic? we still need logits change tested

release-manager: yep plan update: EU pinned to v2.0.1, ff:rollout-model-v2 applies to global except eu-west

deploy-bot: flag update applied: ff:rollout-model-v2=5% (global except eu-west). commands: 
```
rollout set ff:rollout-model-v2 --percent 5 --exclude eu-west
rollout status ff:rollout-model-v2
```

kai: telemetry note: request_ids in canary look clean. small uptick in 95th token latency (+12ms) but within SLOs

oncall: alerting configured: if error-rate > 0.8% for >5m, will pause rollout and notify #eng-oncall

maya.dev: start smoke test prompt set now. will post failures

maya.dev: smoke tests ok for canary so far, 12/12, no semantic regressions on the golden set

release-manager: ramp to 20% in 10m unless we hit the alert. rollback plan: ff off (instant), drain canary nodes, revert pin if needed. tagging release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-20/v2.0.2

sam: quick thought—if we need to rollback, preserve traffic shape by switching to model-slim variant: v2-slim pinned then re-evaluate

deploy-bot: performing scheduled bump to 20% now.

deploy-bot: rollout at 20% complete — health checks 6/6, errors 0.06%

kai: noting a small increase in token generation variance, but quality eval looks stable

maya.dev: smoke tests after bump: 11/12 passed, one flakey test on long-context prompt. investigating

sam: that's the long-context issue we saw earlier. recommend enabling prefix-KV caching for canary only: 
```
config set runtime.cache.prefix_kv=true --scope canary
```

release-manager: go ahead and enable caching for canary. keep EU pinned.

deploy-bot: prefix-KV caching enabled for canary.

maya.dev: re-run smoke: now 12/12 good. merging to ramp schedule. next bump to 50% in 20m

oncall: just a note — scheduled change window ends at 14:00 UTC, keep monitoring

release-manager: adding a quick blurb to release notes about EU pin and cache toggle. notify support to freeze accelerated billing for canary traffic

sam: support notified. Also tagging changelog: "model v2.0.2 gradual rollout; eu pinned to v2.0.1; canary KV caching enabled"

deploy-bot: bump to 50% executed.

deploy-bot: rollout at 50% - health 6/6. error-rate 0.09% (below alert). latency stable.

kai: pushing final telemetry snapshot to dashboard; will watch 1h after final ramp

release-manager: hold for 5m and then full release at 100% if stable. retain pin for eu-west for 1 hour post-release

maya.dev: thumbs up. If anything pops we flip ff to 0 and drain immediately :thumbsup:

sam: recorded postmortem checklist in #eng-releases-docs, will link after final.

deploy-bot: full release triggered — ff:rollout-model-v2=100% global (eu-west excluded)

deploy-bot: release complete. service-inference v2.0.2 is live at 100% (exceptions: eu-west pinned v2.0.1). Tags: release/v2.0.2

release-manager: great job team. follow-up actions: audit logs, update release notes, schedule 1-hr monitoring check-in
